# GrantFit

> GrantFit scores seven funding channels — federal grants, SBIR, state programs, foundations, corporate giving, SBA/CDFI lending, crowdfunding — against your organization and tells you where your odds are real.

GrantFit is a free web tool at https://grantfit.nesohq.com/. It runs in the browser with no account.
It is for nonprofits, small businesses, schools and community organizations looking for funding.

## Questions GrantFit answers

- **How do I know which grants my organization actually qualifies for?** Eligibility is decided by four things: your entity type, where you operate, your annual budget, and whether the funder is chartered to pay for what you want to do.
- **Are federal grants worth pursuing for a small nonprofit or business?** Sometimes, and less often than people assume.
- **What is the difference between a grant, an SBIR award, and a CDFI loan?** A grant is money you do not repay but must spend as promised.
- **How long does grant funding actually take to arrive?** Plan on three to nine months from application to money in the account for most federal and state programs, and six to twelve weeks for foundations.

## Use it

- [Open GrantFit](https://grantfit.nesohq.com/)
